name: Faith Alive
subtitle: Hues That Heal 2.0
welcome: Welcome to Faith Alive, the Hues That Heal 2.0 exhibition. Walk the room and stand with each painting: a journey of love, faith and hope by Olalekan “Swanky” Isiaka.

name: Melody Osagie
subtitle: Featured artist
welcome: Welcome to the room of Melody Osagie, featured artist at Hues That Heal 2.0. Her drawings in charcoal, graphite, acrylic and Ankara fabric speak of surrender, trust and the reward of faith.

name: Hues That Heal 1.0
subtitle: The first collection
welcome: Welcome to Hues That Heal 1.0, where the journey began. Many of these paintings by Olalekan “Swanky” Isiaka have found homes; prints of those are available, and the rest can still be collected.
